models_evaluated: autonomous AI agent with knowledge graph and retrieval-augmented generation

links.outcome: Accuracy of conclusions and care recommendations, grounded agent versus ungrounded LLM baselines
links.effect: Agent using guideline knowledge graph with retrieval-augmented generation achieved 90% overall accuracy in conclusions and care recommendations, compared with 45% for other LLM baselines (20 cases).
links.quote: The agent achieved 100% accuracy in selecting appropriate tools and 90% overall accuracy in generating conclusions and care recommendations, compared with 45% for other large language model baselines.

unlisted_practices: Integrating validated delirium assessment tools with an LLM agent through tool selection
Building a delirium-specific knowledge graph from clinical guidelines to support nursing decision support

screen.reason: This proof-of-concept study developed and evaluated an autonomous RAG-based AI agent to assist nurse-led delirium screening across 20 clinical cases compared to baseline LLMs. As it describes the development and benchmark of a new agent system rather than evaluating an organizational deployment practice or safeguard, tests_practice is false.
